idea-plugin.name: ai-commit-message
idea-plugin.description:
Generate commit messages with AI, right from the commit message toolbar.
  • Click AI Generate to turn the diff of your selected changes into a commit message.
  • Use the dropdown to switch provider profiles and models.
  • Includes publisher-hosted free models with no API key setup.
  • Works with any OpenAI-compatible API, and can fetch the model list from the provider.
  • Customizable prompt template and output language.

在提交信息工具栏上用 AI 生成提交文案。
  • 点击 AI Generate，把勾选变更的 diff 转成提交信息。
  • 通过下拉菜单切换模型配置和具体模型。
  • 内置由发布者托管的免费模型，无需配置 API Key。
  • 兼容任意 OpenAI 接口，并支持从上游拉取模型列表。
  • 可自定义 Prompt 模板与输出语言。
